data.value: APCB: the BIOS option tokens are read from the SPI flash on demand and added to the debug report

data.value: New APCB window (Advanced mode): the BIOS options stored in the booted APCB with their names and defaults, and the DFE / 2D training options next to the trained values

data.value: APOB: the table is found from its address in the BIOS image (ROM2 and ROM3 flash windows), with known addresses as the fallback

data.value: APOB: the PawnIO module and InpOut lookups share a common driver base, selectable by option or in code

data.value: The inpoutx64 driver is left installed on exit while another application is using it
